title: Mitochondrial Structure and Function
learning_goals: Identify the main structural components of a mitochondrion.
Explain the function of each mitochondrial component.
Describe how the structure supports oxidative phosphorylation and ATP production.

segments.text: Let's start with an overview of the mitochondrion, the cell's power plant.
The outer membrane encloses the organelle and controls the entry of molecules.
Between the two membranes lies the intermembrane space, where protons accumulate during electron transport.
The inner membrane, folded into cristae, hosts the proteins of the electron transport chain.
Inside the inner membrane is the matrix, containing mitochondrial DNA and enzymes for the Krebs cycle.
Together, these structures enable oxidative phosphorylation, producing ATP in the mitochondrion.
